review:
Hot to Burn Multiplier is the fifth game in Pragmatic Play's retro Hot to Burn series. It plays on a 5x3 grid with five paylines and old-school fruit-machine symbols, with lucky sevens paying the most.

The single twist is the flame. When a flame lands on any symbol it adds a 1x multiplier, and the total number of flames sets the multiplier applied to that win, up to 5x. That keeps the game simple: no free spins, just quick spins with an occasional multiplied hit. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a maximum win on the page. The RTP is 96.51%. It suits players who want a fast classic slot rather than a feature-heavy one.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
